I will be loading in the NSSATS data and collecting the variables that are relevant to types of services offered.

```{r load data}
nssats_folder <- here("series", "TC_Ownership", "data", "raw")

nssats_files <- list.files(
  path = nssats_folder,
  pattern = "(^nss|^nsum)",
  full.names = T
)

# listing variables that identify services in each set of years - full disclosure, used NSUMHSS into GPT5
variables_list <- c(
  "FOCUS",
  "CTYPEHI1","CTYPEHI2","CTYPE7","CTYPERC1","CTYPERC3","CTYPERC4","CTYPE1",
  "YEAR",
  "OWNERSHP",
  "OWNERSHIP"
)

env <- new.env()

clean_one <- function(file) {
  base_name <- file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))

  # load the single file into a temp env
  temp_env <- new.env()
  load(file, envir = temp_env)
  obj_name <- ls(temp_env)[1]
  raw <- temp_env[[obj_name]]

  # extract year if present in filename
  year <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(base_name, "\\d{4}")))

  # start cleaning
  cleaned <- raw

  # standardize OWNERSHP if present
  if ("OWNERSHP" %in% names(cleaned)) {
    cleaned <- cleaned %>% mutate(OWNERSHP = as.numeric(unclass(OWNERSHP)))
  }

  # drop FOCUS == 2 if FOCUS exists
  if ("FOCUS" %in% names(cleaned)) {
    cleaned <- cleaned %>%
      filter(as.numeric(unclass(FOCUS)) != 2)
  }

  # NSUMHSS variant: drop *_MH and strip "_SU"
  if (startsWith(tolower(base_name), "nsumhss_")) {
    mh_vars <- grep("_MH$", names(cleaned), value = TRUE)
    if (length(mh_vars)) cleaned <- cleaned %>% select(-all_of(mh_vars))

    su_vars <- grep("_SU$", names(cleaned), value = TRUE)
    if (length(su_vars)) {
      names(cleaned)[match(su_vars, names(cleaned))] <- sub("_SU$", "", su_vars)
    }
  }

  # keep only desired variables (using raw names)
  cleaned <- cleaned %>% select(any_of(variables_list))

  # apply payment renames (new = old)
# to_rename <- intersect(names(paymap), names(cleaned))
# 
# if (length(to_rename) > 0) {
#   cleaned <- cleaned %>%
#     rename(!!! set_names(syms(to_rename), paymap[to_rename]))
# }

  # ensure we have YEAR even if not in file name
  if (!("YEAR" %in% names(cleaned)) && !is.na(year)) {
    cleaned <- cleaned %>% mutate(YEAR = year)
  }

  # clean ownership
    if("OWNERSHIP" %in% names(cleaned)) { 
          cleaned <- cleaned %>%
          mutate(
            ownership_type = case_when(
          OWNERSHIP == 1 ~ "For-profit",
          OWNERSHIP == 2 ~ "Non-profit",
          OWNERSHIP %in% c(3, 4, 5, 6) ~ "Public",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
          )
    }    
        if("OWNERSHP" %in% names(cleaned)) { 
          cleaned <- cleaned %>%
          mutate(
            ownership_type = case_when(
          OWNERSHP == 1 ~ "For-profit",
          OWNERSHP == 2 ~ "Non-profit",
          OWNERSHP %in% c(3, 4, 5, 6) ~ "Public",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
          )
    }   

  cleaned
}

cleaned_list <- map(nssats_files, clean_one)

# ensure the list has nice names
names(cleaned_list) <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(nssats_files))

list2env(cleaned_list, envir = .GlobalEnv)
```

```{r}
# --- Ownership × SU care-type breakdown across many files (robust) ---

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(haven)    # zap_labels / read_dta / read_sav
library(readr)    # read_csv

# ---- 0) Inputs ----
# nssats_folder <- here("series", "TC_Ownership", "data", "raw")
nssats_files <- list.files(
  path = nssats_folder,
  pattern = "(^nss|^nsum)",   # adjust if needed
  full.names = TRUE
)

# ---- 1) Helpers ----
# Integer-ish parser
as01 <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
  if (inherits(x, "haven_labelled")) x <- haven::zap_labels(x)
  if (is.factor(x)) x <- as.character(x)

  if (is.numeric(x))  return(as.integer(x))
  if (is.logical(x))  return(as.integer(x))

  if (is.character(x)) {
    d  <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(stringr::str_extract(x, "\\d+")))
    lx <- stringr::str_to_lower(stringr::str_trim(x))
    yn <- dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(d) & d %in% 0:1 ~ d,
      grepl("^\\(?\\s*yes\\b|^\\(?\\s*y\\b|^true\\b",  lx) ~ 1L,
      grepl("^\\(?\\s*no\\b|^\\(?\\s*n\\b|^false\\b", lx) ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
    return(as.integer(yn))
  }
  as.integer(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)))
}

# ---- 1.5) State normalization helper (LOCATIONSTATE / STATE / STFIPS only) ----
# State lookup (50 states + DC)
state_names <- tibble::tibble(
  state      = c(state.abb, "DC"),
  state_name = c(state.name, "District of Columbia")
)
state_fips_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~state, ~fips,
  "AL",1,  "AK",2,  "AZ",4,  "AR",5,  "CA",6,  "CO",8,  "CT",9,  "DE",10, "DC",11,
  "FL",12, "GA",13, "HI",15, "ID",16, "IL",17, "IN",18, "IA",19, "KS",20,
  "KY",21, "LA",22, "ME",23, "MD",24, "MA",25, "MI",26, "MN",27, "MS",28,
  "MO",29, "MT",30, "NE",31, "NV",32, "NH",33, "NJ",34, "NM",35, "NY",36,
  "NC",37, "ND",38, "OH",39, "OK",40, "OR",41, "PA",42, "RI",44, "SC",45,
  "SD",46, "TN",47, "TX",48, "UT",49, "VT",50, "VA",51, "WA",53, "WV",54,
  "WI",55, "WY",56
)
state_lookup <- dplyr::left_join(state_names, state_fips_map, by = "state")
stopifnot(nrow(state_lookup) == 51L, all(!is.na(state_lookup$fips)))

normalize_state <- function(df, has) {
  # 1) STFIPS first: numeric OR strings like "(54) WEST VIRGINIA"
  if (has("STFIPS")) {
    x <- df[["STFIPS"]]; if (inherits(x, "haven_labelled")) x <- haven::zap_labels(x)
    xnum <- if (is.numeric(x)) as.integer(x) else suppressWarnings(as.integer(stringr::str_extract(as.character(x), "\\d+")))
    out <- state_lookup$state[match(xnum, state_lookup$fips)]
    if (!all(is.na(out))) return(out)
  }
  # 2) LOCATIONSTATE next (USPS / full name / strings like "US-CA")
  if (has("LOCATIONSTATE")) {
    x <- df[["LOCATIONSTATE"]]; if (inherits(x, "haven_labelled")) x <- haven::zap_labels(x)
    up <- stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_trim(as.character(x)))
    out <- ifelse(up %in% state_lookup$state, up, NA_character_)
    miss <- is.na(out)
    two <- stringr::str_extract(up, "\\b[A-Z]{2}\\b")
    out[miss & two %in% state_lookup$state] <- two[miss & two %in% state_lookup$state]
    miss <- is.na(out)
    up_clean <- gsub("[^A-Z ]", "", up)
    idx <- match(up_clean, toupper(state_lookup$state_name))
    out[miss & !is.na(idx)] <- state_lookup$state[idx[miss & !is.na(idx)]]
    if (!all(is.na(out))) return(out)
  }
  # 3) STATE last — treat as FIPS only if it looks like FIPS in bulk
  if (has("STATE")) {
    x <- df[["STATE"]]; if (inherits(x, "haven_labelled")) x <- haven::zap_labels(x)
    if (is.numeric(x)) {
      xnum <- as.integer(x); valid <- xnum %in% state_lookup$fips
      if (mean(valid, na.rm = TRUE) >= 0.8) {
        out <- state_lookup$state[match(xnum, state_lookup$fips)]
        if (!all(is.na(out))) return(out)
      }
    } else {
      ch  <- as.character(x)
      up  <- stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_trim(ch))
      out <- ifelse(up %in% state_lookup$state, up, NA_character_)
      miss <- is.na(out)
      if (any(miss)) {
        up_clean <- gsub("[^A-Z ]", "", up)
        idx <- match(up_clean, toupper(state_lookup$state_name))
        out[miss & !is.na(idx)] <- state_lookup$state[idx[miss & !is.na(idx)]]
      }
      miss <- is.na(out)
      if (any(miss)) {
        digs <- stringr::str_extract(up, "\\d+")
        xnum <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(digs))
        out[miss] <- state_lookup$state[match(xnum[miss], state_lookup$fips)]
      }
      if (!all(is.na(out))) return(out)
    }
  }
  rep(NA_character_, nrow(df))
}

# ---- 2) Single-file cleaner (returns SAME columns every time) ----
clean_one <- function(file) {
  base_name  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
  year_guess <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(stringr::str_extract(base_name, "\\d{4}")))

  # Loader
  if (grepl("\\.(RData|rdata|rda|Rda)$", file)) {
    temp_env <- new.env(); load(file, envir = temp_env); nm <- ls(temp_env)
    if (!length(nm)) stop("No object inside ", file)
    obj <- temp_env[[nm[1]]]
  } else if (grepl("\\.(rds)$", file, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    obj <- readRDS(file)
  } else if (grepl("\\.(sav)$", file, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    obj <- haven::read_sav(file)
  } else if (grepl("\\.(dta)$", file, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    obj <- haven::read_dta(file)
  } else if (grepl("\\.(csv)$", file, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    obj <- readr::read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  } else stop("Unsupported file type: ", file)

  df <- as.data.frame(obj)

  # helpers (pre-filter)
  has  <- function(v) v %in% names(df)
  vcol <- function(name) if (has(name)) as01(df[[name]]) else NULL

  # Keep SU module if FOCUS exists (drop MH-only = 2)
  if (has("FOCUS")) {
    if (inherits(df$FOCUS, "haven_labelled")) df$FOCUS <- haven::zap_labels(df$FOCUS)
    df <- dplyr::filter(df, as.integer(FOCUS) != 2L)
  }

  # NSUMHSS: drop *_MH, strip _SU
  if (startsWith(tolower(base_name), "nsumhss_")) {
    mh_vars <- grep("_MH$", names(df), value = TRUE)
    if (length(mh_vars)) df <- dplyr::select(df, -dplyr::all_of(mh_vars))
    su_vars <- grep("_SU$", names(df), value = TRUE)
    if (length(su_vars)) names(df)[match(su_vars, names(df))] <- sub("_SU$", "", su_vars)
  }

  # Rebuild helpers AFTER df has changed
  has  <- function(v) v %in% names(df)
  vcol <- function(name) if (has(name)) as01(df[[name]]) else NULL

  # ---- derive STATE *after* filtering/munging ----
  state <- normalize_state(df, has)

  # Survey year (prefer YEAR col if present, otherwise filename)
  yr_col <- if (has("YEAR")) as01(df$YEAR) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(df))
  survey_year <- if (!all(is.na(yr_col))) as.integer(yr_col[1]) else year_guess
  if (is.na(survey_year)) survey_year <- year_guess

  # Build care flags (legacy ≤2011 vs modern)
  if (!is.na(survey_year) && survey_year <= 2011) {
    x_out <- list(vcol("CTYPE1"), vcol("CTYPE2"), vcol("CTYPE3"), vcol("CTYPE6"), vcol("CTYPEML"), vcol("CTYPEOP"))
    x_res <- list(vcol("CTYPE7"), vcol("CTYPERC1"), vcol("CTYPERC2"), vcol("CTYPERC3"), vcol("CTYPERC4"))
    x_inp <- list(vcol("CTYPE4"), vcol("CTYPEHI1"), vcol("CTYPEHI2"))
  } else {
    x_out <- list(vcol("CTYPE1"))
    x_res <- list(vcol("CTYPE7"), vcol("CTYPERC1"), vcol("CTYPERC3"), vcol("CTYPERC4"))
    x_inp <- list(vcol("CTYPEHI1"), vcol("CTYPEHI2"))
  }

  x_out <- purrr::compact(x_out); x_res <- purrr::compact(x_res); x_inp <- purrr::compact(x_inp)
  x_out <- if (length(x_out)) do.call(pmax, c(x_out, list(na.rm=TRUE))) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(df))
  x_res <- if (length(x_res)) do.call(pmax, c(x_res, list(na.rm=TRUE))) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(df))
  x_inp <- if (length(x_inp)) do.call(pmax, c(x_inp, list(na.rm=TRUE))) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(df))

  su_outpatient  <- as.integer(replace(x_out, is.na(x_out), 0L) > 0)
  su_residential <- as.integer(replace(x_res, is.na(x_res), 0L) > 0)
  su_inpatient   <- as.integer(replace(x_inp, is.na(x_inp), 0L) > 0)

  # YEAR column (vectorized fill)
  YEAR <- as.integer(ifelse(is.na(yr_col), rep(survey_year, nrow(df)), yr_col))

  # Ownership mapping
  ownership_type <- NA_character_
  if (!is.na(survey_year) && survey_year <= 2011) {
    if (has("OWNERSHP")) {
      codes <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(stringr::str_extract(as.character(df$OWNERSHP), "\\d+")))
      ownership_type <- dplyr::case_when(
        codes == 1 ~ "For-profit",
        codes == 2 ~ "Non-profit",
        codes %in% 3:6 ~ "Public",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    } else {
      ownership_type <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(df))
    }
  } else {
    get_owner_code <- function(x) {
      if (inherits(x, "haven_labelled")) x <- haven::zap_labels(x)
      if (is.factor(x)) x <- as.character(x)
      if (is.numeric(x)) return(as.integer(x))
      if (is.character(x)) return(suppressWarnings(as.integer(stringr::str_extract(x, "\\d+"))))
      suppressWarnings(as.integer(x))
    }
    if (has("OWNERSHIP")) {
      oc <- get_owner_code(df$OWNERSHIP)
    } else if (has("OWNERSHP")) {
      oc <- get_owner_code(df$OWNERSHP)
    } else {
      oc <- rep(NA_integer_, nrow(df))
    }
    ownership_type <- dplyr::case_when(
      oc == 1 ~ "For-profit",
      oc == 2 ~ "Non-profit",
      oc %in% 3:6 ~ "Public",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  }

  # ---- Sanity check: lengths must match nrow(df) ----
  n <- nrow(df)
  lens <- c(
    YEAR            = length(YEAR),
    state           = length(state),
    ownership_type  = length(ownership_type),
    su_outpatient   = length(su_outpatient),
    su_residential  = length(su_residential),
    su_inpatient    = length(su_inpatient)
  )
  if (!all(lens == n)) {
    stop(
      sprintf("Tibble columns must have compatible sizes. nrow(df)=%d | lengths -> %s",
              n,
              paste(sprintf("%s:%d", names(lens), lens), collapse=", "))
    )
  }

  # Return a tibble with consistent columns and types
  tibble::tibble(
    YEAR = as.integer(YEAR),
    state = as.character(state),
    ownership_type = as.character(ownership_type),
    su_outpatient  = as.integer(su_outpatient),
    su_residential = as.integer(su_residential),
    su_inpatient   = as.integer(su_inpatient)
  )
}

# ---- 3) Run cleaner across all files & bind (robust) ----
cleaned_list <- map(
  nssats_files,
  \(f) tryCatch(clean_one(f), error = function(e) { message("Skipped: ", basename(f), " -> ", e$message); NULL })
)

# keep only data frames/tibbles, drop NULLs
cleaned_list <- purrr::keep(cleaned_list, ~ inherits(.x, "data.frame"))
if (!length(cleaned_list)) stop("No files produced data. Check file patterns and loader.")

# ensure each element has the same columns (last guard)
need_cols <- c("YEAR","state","ownership_type","su_outpatient","su_residential","su_inpatient")
cleaned_list <- map(cleaned_list, \(x) {
  miss <- setdiff(need_cols, names(x))
  if (length(miss)) x[miss] <- NA
  x[need_cols]
})

panel <- dplyr::bind_rows(cleaned_list)

# ---- 4) Ownership × care-type shares by year ----
care_by_own <- panel %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ownership_type), !is.na(YEAR)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(YEAR, ownership_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_fac = dplyr::n(),
    share_outpatient  = mean(su_outpatient  == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    share_residential = mean(su_residential == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    share_inpatient   = mean(su_inpatient   == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(care_by_own)

# ---- 5) (Optional) Plot: ownership vs care type (latest year available) ----
if (nrow(care_by_own)) {
  latest_year <- max(care_by_own$YEAR, na.rm = TRUE)

  plot_df <- care_by_own %>%
    dplyr::filter(YEAR == latest_year) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      c(share_outpatient, share_residential, share_inpatient),
      names_to = "care_type", values_to = "share"
    )

  gg <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = ownership_type, y = share, fill = care_type)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Substance Use Care Types by Ownership (", latest_year, ")"),
      x = "Ownership type", y = "Share of facilities",
      fill = "Care type"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

  print(gg)
} else {
  message("No rows in care_by_own after filtering. Check ownership parsing or YEAR detection.")
}

saveRDS(panel, here("series","TC_Ownership","data","clean","panel_su_flags.rds"))
```

```{r}
#1 inspect
inspect_legacy <- function(file) {
  # raw
  env <- new.env(); load(file, envir = env)
  raw <- as.data.frame(env[[ls(env)[1]]])

  # parsed (your cleaner)
  parsed <- clean_one(file)

  cat("\n---", basename(file), "---\n")
  # Ownership: show raw labels and parsed mapping (first 20)
  if ("OWNERSHP" %in% names(raw)) {
    cat("Raw OWNERSHP examples:\n")
    print(unique(head(as.character(raw$OWNERSHP), 20)))
  } else {
    cat("OWNERSHP NOT FOUND in raw\n")
  }

  cat("\nParsed ownership_type head():\n")
  print(head(parsed$ownership_type, 20))

  # Care flags: show shares and whether all-zero
  s <- summarise(parsed,
    n = n(),
    share_out = mean(su_outpatient==1, na.rm=TRUE),
    share_res = mean(su_residential==1, na.rm=TRUE),
    share_inp = mean(su_inpatient==1, na.rm=TRUE)
  )
  print(s)

  invisible(parsed)
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ensure consistent ownership order
panel <- panel %>%
  mutate(ownership_type = factor(ownership_type,
                                 levels = c("For-profit","Non-profit","Public")))

# Helper: compute, for a given care flag, the share of that care type owned by each ownership group
# Denominator each year = number of facilities that OFFER that care type
summarize_ownership_share <- function(df, care_var, care_label) {
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(YEAR), !is.na(ownership_type)) %>%
    mutate(care = .data[[care_var]] == 1) %>%
    group_by(YEAR) %>%
    mutate(total_care = sum(care, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(total_care > 0) %>%                                 # avoid 0-denominator years
    group_by(YEAR, ownership_type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_care_owned = sum(care, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_care   = first(total_care),
      share_owned  = n_care_owned / total_care,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(care_type = care_label)
}

# Build three series
out_own <- summarize_ownership_share(panel, "su_outpatient",  "Outpatient")
res_own <- summarize_ownership_share(panel, "su_residential", "Residential")
inp_own <- summarize_ownership_share(panel, "su_inpatient",   "Inpatient")

# Plot function (one chart per care type)
plot_ownership_share <- function(df_care) {
  ggplot(df_care, aes(x = YEAR, y = share_owned, color = ownership_type)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.1) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0,1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#1f77b4","#2ca02c","#d62728")) +  # optional; remove if you prefer defaults
    labs(
      title = paste0("Ownership Share of ", unique(df_care$care_type), " Facilities Over Time"),
      x = "Year",
      y = "Share of facilities offering this care type",
      color = "Ownership"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

# Create the three separate plots
p_out <- plot_ownership_share(out_own)
p_res <- plot_ownership_share(res_own)
p_inp <- plot_ownership_share(inp_own)

# Print them (in order)
print(p_out)
ggsave(here("series", "TC_Ownership", "output", "outpatient_shares.png"))
print(p_res)
ggsave(here("series", "TC_Ownership", "output", "residential_shares.png"))
print(p_inp)
ggsave(here("series", "TC_Ownership", "output", "inpatient_shares.png"))






```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)
library(stringr)

# 1) Compute state-level nonprofit share for RESIDENTIAL (2023)
res_2023 <- panel %>%
  filter(YEAR == 2023, !is.na(state)) %>%
  filter(su_residential == 1) %>%                         # <-- residential denominator
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(
    n_res = n(),
    share_np = mean(ownership_type == "Non-profit", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2) USPS -> map region names (maps::map_data doesn't include DC polygons)
usps_to_name <- tibble::tibble(
  state_usps = c(state.abb, "DC"),
  state_name = c(state.name, "District of Columbia")
) %>% mutate(region = tolower(state_name))

res_map <- res_2023 %>% left_join(usps_to_name, by = c("state" = "state_usps"))
us_map <- map_data("state")
plot_df <- us_map %>% left_join(res_map, by = "region")

# Optional: grey out states with tiny Ns (e.g., < 5 residential facilities)
# plot_df <- plot_df %>% mutate(share_np = ifelse(n_res < 5, NA_real_, share_np))

# 3) Choropleth (two-color sequential scale: white -> dark blue)
ggplot(plot_df, aes(long, lat, group = group, fill = share_np)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", size = 0.25) +
  coord_fixed(1.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    name   = "Non-profit share",
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    low = "white", high = "darkblue",
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Share of Residential Substance Use Treatment Centers that are Non-profit (2023)",
    caption = "Source: NSSATS/NSUMHSS panel"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )



ggsave(here("series", "TC_Ownership", "output", "res_by_state_own.png"))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

np_share_by_state <- panel %>%
  filter(YEAR == 2023, !is.na(state)) %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(
    share_np_out = mean(ownership_type == "Non-profit" & su_outpatient == 1, na.rm = TRUE) /

    share_np_res = mean(ownership_type == "Non-profit" & su_residential == 1, na.rm = TRUE) /

    .groups = "drop"
  )

library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

np_long <- np_share_by_state %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("share_np"),
               names_to = "service_type", values_to = "share") %>%
  mutate(service_type = recode(service_type,
                               share_np_out = "Outpatient",
                               share_np_res = "Residential",
                               share_np_inp = "Inpatient"))

ggplot(np_long, aes(x = service_type, y = share, fill = service_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(title = "Nonprofit share of facilities by service type (2023)",
       y = "Share nonprofit", x = "") +
  theme_minimal()

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)

# 1) Compute nonprofit shares within each service type, by state
np_share_by_state <- panel %>%
  filter(YEAR == 2023, !is.na(state)) %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(
    share_np_out = mean(ownership_type == "Non-profit" & su_outpatient == 1, na.rm = TRUE) /
                   mean(su_outpatient == 1, na.rm = TRUE),

    share_np_res = mean(ownership_type == "Non-profit" & su_residential == 1, na.rm = TRUE) /
                   mean(su_residential == 1, na.rm = TRUE),

    share_np_inp = mean(ownership_type == "Non-profit" & su_inpatient == 1, na.rm = TRUE) /
                   mean(su_inpatient == 1, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    share_np_high = pmax(share_np_res, share_np_inp, na.rm = TRUE),   # residential/inpatient "high-acuity"
    diff_out_vs_high = share_np_out - share_np_high
  )

# 2) Join with state map polygons
usps_to_name <- tibble::tibble(
  state_usps = c(state.abb, "DC"),
  state_name = c(state.name, "District of Columbia")
) %>%
  mutate(region = tolower(state_name))

share_map <- np_share_by_state %>%
  left_join(usps_to_name, by = c("state" = "state_usps"))

us_map <- map_data("state")

plot_df <- us_map %>%
  left_join(share_map, by = "region")

# 3) Choropleth of the difference
ggplot(plot_df, aes(long, lat, group = group, fill = diff_out_vs_high)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", size = 0.25) +
  coord_fixed(1.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    name = "NP Outpatient –\nNP In/Res",
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    low = "red", mid = "white", high = "blue", midpoint = 0,
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Difference in Nonprofit Share: Outpatient vs Inpatient/Residential (2023)",
    subtitle = "Blue = more nonprofit dominance in outpatient; Red = more in inpatient/residential",
    caption = "Source: NSSATS/NSUMHSS panel"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )


```
